author: Ariadne I
title: Osc2-CTX-FLoad-LN (k=320, p=28, H=96, γ_end=0.99) + V-OrthoReg
abstract: LN variant capacity sweep on proj_rank p from 32 to 28 with hidden size H=96. Keeps γ_end=0.99, residual copy, MAE+curvature, and V-orthogonality (λ=1e-5). Optimizer unchanged (Adam) to isolate p effect.
